title: MEDVi reviews: BBB rating, cost, and a FutureClinic option - FutureClinic
summary: MEDVi reviews, November 2026 GLP-1 prices, BBB complaints, and how a $40 FutureClinic doctor visit compares for brand Wegovy or Zepbound self-pay.
body_markdown:
## Are MEDVi's compounded GLP-1s FDA-approved?


MEDVi's prescriptions come from OpenLoop Health clinicians after an online consultation, and state-licensed pharmacies dispense the compounded drugs, which MEDVi's own page states are not FDA-approved. The[FDA states](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/postmarket-drug-safety-information-patients-and-providers/fdas-concerns-unapproved-glp-1-drugs-used-weight-loss) that compounded drugs are not reviewed for safety, effectiveness, or quality before they are marketed. As of May 31, 2026, the agency logged 990 adverse event reports for compounded semaglutide and over 730 for compounded tirzepatide, and the[American Diabetes Association](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12690185/) (2026) advises against unapproved compounded GLP-1s.


## Who should pick MEDVi


MEDVi fits people who specifically want compounded semaglutide (or the compounded tirzepatide in its checkout price list) from its partner pharmacies; FutureClinic has no compounded GLP-1 or formula of its own, and its doctors prescribe only FDA-approved GLP-1s. It also suits people who want the medicine priced into one recurring bill and shipped in the plan; FutureClinic sends prescriptions only to the pharmacy you choose and doesn't sell or bundle the medicine. And it suits people who want its care coaching team, led by certified medical assistants and registered dietitians. On FutureClinic, care is by message with no video visits, and a doctor replies in hours, not minutes: typically the same day.


## A physician of your own for weight loss


Do you want a company's program with its compounded medicine bundled into one bill, or a doctor of your own and an FDA-approved medicine you can fill anywhere? If you want what MEDVi packages beyond the clinician, its plan is built for that. If you wanted one-to-one care from an expert physician, FutureClinic gives you that with nothing attached.


Every FutureClinic doctor is a state-licensed, background-checked, board-certified physician (MD, DO or MBBS), never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant. We have over 300 doctors on the platform. They span more than 60 specialties, generalists and specialists alike. No form is approved in bulk: a specific physician reads your history before deciding, which matters because the[Wegovy](https://www.novo-pi.com/wegovy.pdf) and[Zepbound](https://pi.lilly.com/us/zepbound-uspi.pdf) labels carry a boxed warning on thyroid C-cell tumors and warn of acute pancreatitis. Your doctor sends a written plan and a Human Signature, a short video or voice note recorded live for you.


Your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test. Prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, and FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations when insurance requires one. Since July 1, 2026, the[Medicare GLP-1 Bridge](https://www.medicare.gov/publications/12234-medicare-glp-1-bridge-glp-1-drugs-for-50-a-month.pdf) has let eligible Part D enrollees pay $50 a month for Wegovy, Foundayo or Zepbound KwikPen.


You can message the same doctor over time to adjust doses, manage side effects, or switch medicines. That doctor can help with other problems in their specialty, and every FutureClinic doctor you see works from your one medical record. Most doctors also offer an optional membership, typically $25 to $100 a month, for unlimited care with them.


## Where to get a weight-loss evaluation on FutureClinic


FutureClinic works in 34 states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. Your doctor must be licensed in your state; if you don't see yours here, try anyway since FutureClinic may have opened there.


Visit[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) and you can start a conversation with a doctor right away; you can even do it from your AI app at[futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) or with this line:


> ` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911 in an emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
